create_LinearCoordinateMapping: create a LinearCoordinateMapping with scale and bias to transform spatial positions
build_Conv2dCoordinateMapping: build a Conv2dCoordinateMapping from a torch Conv2d, MaxPool2d, or ConvTranspose2d module
compose_CoordinateMappings: compose multiple CoordinateMappings using addition to chain sequential transformations
manage_CoordinateMappingComposer: manage bidirectional coordinate mappings between named nodes with a CoordinateMappingComposer
extract_mapping_from_module: extract a CoordinateMapping from a torch.nn module via mapping_from_torch_module
